claim: From 8th October the UK government will combine weekly flu and covid reports.
justification: The high-confidence evidence from Fact-check A, with scores of 0.80 to 0.90, consistently states that the UK government did not announce or begin publishing combined weekly flu and COVID-19 reports on or after October 8, 2020. Specifically, evidence items with confidence 0.90 and 0.85 indicate no official announcement was made and no combined report was initiated on that date. Low-confidence evidence from Fact-check B suggesting otherwise is contradicted and discounted. Therefore, the claim is explicitly refuted by trustworthy evidence.
